changes.zh: 新增手动触发的 GitHub Actions 发布流程，通过双平台检查与浏览器测试后生成插件安装包、校验和及固定格式的双语 Release 说明；npm 仍由维护者手动发布。
changes.en: Added a manually triggered GitHub Actions release workflow that generates an installable package, checksums, and bilingual release notes after cross-platform checks and browser tests; npm publishing remains manual.

changes.zh: 补充开发与发布指南，要求后续功能与修复同步记录简短的中英变更条目。
changes.en: Added development and release guidance requiring concise Chinese and English change entries alongside future features and fixes.
